purpose: Curated source registry for reusable/procedural building, environment, vegetation, material, and Roblox tooling resources.

policy.defaultAssetPolicy: Prefer CC0 or clearly permissive open-source assets; pin hashes; preserve license/provenance.
policy.prohibited: Do not use scraped Google Street View/Google 3D data as an asset source.
policy.security: No unreviewed third-party scripts in environment assets.

resources.name: BasicProceduralBuilding
resources.use: Reference/seed for modular facade generation: doors, windows, pillars, roof pieces, deterministic facade-cell placement.
resources.integration: Study and adapt concepts into UPLB Architecture Kit; do not make it a hard runtime dependency initially.
resources.notes: Includes Blender file and an instanced GLB kit; good model for deterministic Blender↔code parity.

resources.name: Kenney Building Kit
resources.use: Generic modular walls, floors, doors, and windows for placeholder/context assets.
resources.integration: Download selectively; register each adopted asset in the UPLB asset registry; modify to fit campus visual language.
resources.notes: Small pack; ideal for greybox/context use.

resources.name: Kenney City Kit (Roads)
resources.use: Road props, lightposts, construction fences, barriers, generic street pieces.
resources.integration: Use as temporary/context assets; avoid letting kit style define UPLB visual identity.

resources.name: Quaternius Downtown City MegaKit
resources.use: Modular street/building pieces, sidewalks, utility props, facade modules, roof pieces, collision references.
resources.integration: Mine generic components and kit organization patterns; do not copy the city architectural style wholesale.
resources.notes: Large modular pack; selective ingest recommended.

resources.name: Poly Haven
resources.use: PBR materials, realistic generic models, HDRIs.
resources.integration: Download selected CC0 assets and pin them by file hash; do not make worldgen depend on the live API.
resources.notes: Prefer concrete, asphalt, metal, painted surfaces, wood, grass, soil, gravel.

resources.name: Quaternius Ultimate Nature Pack
resources.use: Generic trees, vegetation, rocks, bushes for background/context vegetation.
resources.integration: Use for early vegetation massing; landmark/species-specific UPLB trees should later be custom.
resources.notes: Context vegetation only unless visually verified.

resources.name: Quaternius Stylized Nature MegaKit
resources.use: Alternative generic tree/plant/rock library for stylized or optimized context vegetation.
resources.integration: Evaluate against Roblox visual target and poly budget before adoption.

resources.name: GoodPie/modular_tree
resources.use: Procedural tree generation in Blender, deterministic variation via seeds/presets.
resources.integration: Research and optional offline generator only; verify Blender 5.x compatibility before project dependency.
resources.notes: Useful later for tree pools rather than identical clones.

resources.name: vvoovv/bcga
resources.use: Procedural architecture grammar reference: 2D footprint → extrusion → facade decomposition → floors/windows.
resources.integration: Research algorithms/concepts first. Do not vendor or redistribute until exact license is confirmed.

resources.name: Durman/BuildingNodes
resources.use: Panel-based procedural building style system; useful conceptual model for reusable UPLB facade styles.
resources.integration: Treat as research until Blender 5 compatibility and license are confirmed.
resources.notes: Older Blender target; do not make a required dependency.

resources.name: vvoovv/blosm
resources.license: GPL (source noted by project; verify exact branch/license file before vendoring)
resources.use: Comparison/reference for OSM buildings, roads, terrain, water, and vegetation generation.
resources.integration: Use as a sanity-check/reference renderer, not as canonical world source. Avoid Google-derived workflows.
resources.notes: Project says source is on the release branch; use OSM/terrain ideas only.

resources.name: lune-org/lune
resources.use: Standalone Luau runtime; potential future headless Roblox place/model validation and CI.
resources.integration: Do not add yet unless MCP-only workflow becomes insufficient.

resources.name: Scythe-Technology/luau-roblox
resources.use: Manipulate Roblox place/model files from Luau for future headless validation or generation.
resources.integration: Evaluate later alongside Lune; not needed for first MCP POC.

resources.name: princeofscale/bloxforge
resources.use: Reference implementation for agent↔Roblox Studio workflows, testing, screenshots, provenance, recovery.
resources.integration: Study patterns only for now because Roblox Studio's native MCP is already connected.
resources.notes: Avoid running two Studio bridges unless there is a concrete missing capability.

resources.name: Roblox Creator Store / Studio MCP asset tools
resources.use: Search generic Roblox props such as benches, lamps, fences and context objects.
resources.integration: Only use in disposable Studio; inspect scripts and provenance before adoption; register accepted assets.
resources.notes: No third-party scripts should ship in environment props unless deliberately reviewed.
